source.parser_probe_boundary: no prompt, no credentials, no model request; every variant stops at argv parsing or print-input validation

help_text.--bare: Minimal mode: skip hooks, LSP, plugin sync, attribution, auto-memory, background prefetches, keychain reads, and CLAUDE.md auto-discovery. Sets CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE=1. Anthropic auth is strictly ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or apiKeyHelper via --settings (OAuth and keychain are never read). 3P providers (Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry) use their own credentials. Skills still resolve via /skill-name. Explicitly provide context via: --system-prompt[-file], --append-system-prompt[-file], --add-dir (CLAUDE.md dirs), --mcp-config, --settings, --agents, --plugin-dir.
help_text.--restricted: Restricted mode: removes the built-in tools that run commands or code (Bash, PowerShell, REPL and the other code-running tools) and WebFetch unless --tools names them, and ignores user, project and local settings files (managed settings and --settings still apply; add --strict-mcp-config to skip MCP servers too). Also confines the file tools to the working directories (--add-dir included), refuses bypassPermissions, and lets only a person or the configured permission handler approve writes to settings, git and tool-configuration files.
help_text.--safe-mode: Start with all customizations (CLAUDE.md, skills, plugins, hooks, MCP servers, custom commands and agents, output styles, workflows, custom themes, keybindings, and more) disabled — useful for troubleshooting a broken configuration. Admin-managed (policy) settings still apply. Auth, model selection, built-in tools, and permissions work normally. Sets CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE=1.
help_text.--setting-sources: Comma-separated list of setting sources to load (user, project, local).
help_text.--settings: Path to a settings JSON file or a JSON string to load additional settings from
help_text.--mcp-config: Load MCP servers from JSON files or strings (space-separated)
help_text.--strict-mcp-config: Only use MCP servers from --mcp-config, ignoring all other MCP configurations
help_text.--add-dir: Additional directories to allow tool access to
help_text.--tools: Specify the list of available tools from the built-in set. Use "" to disable all tools, "default" to use all tools, or specify tool names (e.g. "Bash,Edit,Read").
help_text.--permission-mode: Permission mode to use for the session (choices: "acceptEdits", "auto", "bypassPermissions", "manual", "dontAsk", "plan")
help_text.--include-hook-events: Include all hook lifecycle events in the output stream (only works with --output-format=stream-json)
